audit.whatIsWrong: This page gives Volibear five straight rows from level 2. The already-audited mirror ends on Volibear / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Volibear / Illaoi / Skill, and this page's own whys[1] already says levels 2-3 punish you.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap on a flat 4 seconds and Test of Spirit reaches 900 against your 300-range Q — the levels before Stormbringer are hers. 48.99% over 939 games fits a lane that turns only at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-6: Volibear / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Volibear / Illaoi / Skill, ratings 6/4/3/4/7/4/5.

audit.why: Level 6 is the one row that stays Volibear on both sides: Stormbringer is a 550-range leap on 160s that grants bonus health and disables the tower, while Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 and only 450 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: MIS-SLOTTED NAME in four places: 'Test of Spirit (W) grab'. Test of Spirit is her E; her W is Harsh Lesson, and it is the leap, not a grab.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: W Harsh Lesson — 'Illaoi leaps to her target, dealing physical damage and causing nearby Tentacles to also swing at the target' (400 range, 4s). E Test of Spirit — 'rips the spirit from a foe's body' (900 range, 16/15/14/13/12s).
audit.corrected: Test of Spirit (E) is the 900-range spirit pull; Harsh Lesson (W) is the 400-range leap on 4s that makes tentacles swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page says where tentacles come from, only that you should avoid 'her tentacle field'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Illaoi and the Vessels she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain... will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.' Terrain is the variable you control — open ground has no tentacles, and every tentacle hit is sustain for her.
audit.corrected: Fight in the open, away from walls; each tentacle hit heals her, which is why anti-heal goes on before the extended trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] recommends Executioner's Calling and then says it 'cuts his healing'.
audit.why: Illaoi is female and the healing in question is her passive's tentacle heal — the item is right, the sentence is not.

Packet flagged 'Ult Leap of Faith' in wants.foe[1]; the name is correct and the matcher caught the leading verb. The kit file's grounding and untargetable flags on Leap of Faith are not in Riot's description, so I did not assert either.
audit.corrected: No name change. Grounding claim deliberately not written.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Illaoi has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap on 4 seconds — she resets onto you faster than you can walk away.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Illaoi under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you inside its blast, but her tentacles spawn on every wall here and heal her each time they connect.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Illaoi down every time Test of Spirit is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the bite chunk hard, but Test of Spirit reaches 900 and is 16s at rank 1 — one hit turns your own damage back on you.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Illaoi to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky crit-heals your first hit, but her tentacles heal her every time they land — she out-sustains you at first item.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is a skill window — respect her tentacle slams but punish her CS steps.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — she has one tentacle and Harsh Lesson is her only step-up.

edits.before: By Level 3 your Q-W-E kit out-brawls her once you fight off the tentacles.
edits.after: Level 3 her tentacles spawn on every wall and heal her as they hit.

edits.before: Your Q stun and sustain win extended trades outside her tentacle field.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 Test of Spirit reaches 900 against your 300-range Q.

edits.before: First-item Sundered Sky sustain out-lasts her tentacle slams in a brawl.
edits.after: First item her tentacle slams and passive heal out-sustain Sundered Sky.

edits.before: Once you can Q-run in, W-heal, and E-zone, you beat Illaoi outside her tentacles — but early Level 2-3 her Tentacle slams and Test of Spirit (W) grab punish you if you fight on top of her Es.
edits.after: Illaoi owns this window: Harsh Lesson (W) is a 400-range leap on 4 seconds that makes every nearby tentacle swing, and Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 — fight in open ground, away from walls.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are a skill window — respect Illaoi's Tentacle (E-summoned) slams but punish her when she reaches for CS with your Passive autos. Don't get grabbed by Test of Spirit (W) and the lane stays even.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — tentacles spawn on impassible terrain, so fight in the open where she only has one. Punish her when she reaches for CS with your Passive autos, and never eat Test of Spirit (E) next to a wall.

edits.before: By Level 3 you take over. Your Q run-down, W sustain, and E zoning let you fight her cleanly as long as you drag the fight off her tentacles. Land a Q stun outside the field and you win the trade every time.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 belong to Illaoi. Test of Spirit reaches 900 against your 300-range Q, Harsh Lesson resets onto you every 4 seconds, and each tentacle hit heals her. Farm, hold your stun, and wait for 6.

edits.after: Bait you next to a wall, then Test of Spirit (E) you into a Vessel

edits.after: - Test of Spirit (E): matchup-defining — 900 range, 16s. - Harsh Lesson (W): a 400 leap every 4s. - R: 120s.

edits.after: Test of Spirit (E) is 900 range on 16s; Harsh Lesson (W) is a 400 leap every 4s that swings her tentacles.

notes: The chart flip follows the mirror, but note that volibear's own packet chart disagrees with it on rows 2, 3 and 5 (packet says Volibear, mirror says Illaoi). I went with the mirror because it is already written and because this page's whys[1] independently described levels 2-3 as hers. The kit file flags Leap of Faith as grounding and untargetable; Riot's description says neither, so nothing on the page asserts it.
